feed.subtitle: Updates from mariosinani.com: papers, talks and positions.

entry.title: The site gets a lab, a talks page, a colophon and this feed
entry.summary: Five live models from the papers now run in the browser, with a control for each. New pages for talks and for how the site is made.

entry.title: I start as a researcher with the NSF AI Institute in Dynamic Systems
entry.summary: Deep learning for scientific model discovery, with the NSF AI Institute in Dynamic Systems and the University of Washington, in Seattle.

entry.title: Data-Driven Parametric Aeroelastic Modeling of the Pazy Wing, at AIAA SciTech
entry.summary: I present the parametric Pazy wing paper at the AIAA SciTech Forum in Orlando.

entry.title: Our multibody model of flared hinged wings appears in Computer Physics Communications
entry.summary: An absolute nodal coordinate formulation for the nonlinear multibody modeling of flared hinged wings.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Data-Driven Modelling of the Pazy Wing, at AIAA SciTech
entry.summary: I present the physics-informed Pazy wing paper at the AIAA SciTech Forum in Orlando.

entry.title: Our bound on nonlinear modal energy transfer, at the IEEE CDC
entry.summary: I present the semidefinite-programming bound on modal energy transfer for geometrically exact beams at the IEEE Conference on Decision and Control in Milan.
